jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer
jobs.description:
## The Role

• Set our security priorities and see fixes through until they are verified.

• Secure our cloud and our identities on Google Cloud and Kubernetes: access rights, keys and secrets, network exposure and backups.

• Build logging and detection, and automate checks so they run without you.

• Work with the engineers on application security: threat modelling, review of sensitive code paths, checks in the build pipeline and patch management.

• Design the controls around payouts and the separation between partners.

• Lead incident response, including the plan and the exercises.

• Run our security testing: a yearly external penetration test and automated, AI-assisted testing in between.

• Write the few rules we need, for customer data and for partners, vendors and AI agents, short enough that people follow them.

## What you bring

• 6+ years in engineering, at least 3 of them hands-on in security. You started in backend, platform or infrastructure work.

• Strong cloud and identity security, ideally on Google Cloud, and experience with Kubernetes.

• Solid application security: you can review code and show an engineer the fix.

• You have built security in a small or growing company, not only worked inside a large security team.

• You have led the response to a security incident.

• You use AI tools every day.

• Fluent English.
 Nice to have

• PHP, or TypeScript and Node.

• Database security on MySQL or PostgreSQL.

• Multi-tenant platforms and payment or payout flows.

• Single sign-on and build pipeline security.

• Swiss and EU data protection law.

• German.

## Why join us?

• The whole problem. You build the security function and lead it as it grows, with the backing of the management.

• Hands on the systems. This is an engineering role. There is no team to manage at the start, and policies and audits are a small part of the work.

• Real stakes. Royalties and customer data for artists and labels run through the systems you protect.

• AI-native team. Agents are tools you use and actors you secure.

• Flexibility. Remote with flexible hours, and an office in Zurich when you want it.
 Our stack
Google Cloud and Kubernetes, GitLab, TypeScript and Node, PHP, MySQL and PostgreSQL.

How to apply
 Apply with your CV and a few lines on a security control you built: what it was, what your part was, and whether it still runs.
 Please apply only through the application form linked to this ad. We cannot consider applications sent by email.
 What happens next: a short first call, a practical exercise, and a conversation with the engineers you would work with.

## About us

iGroove is a profitable Swiss music company. We deliver music to the streaming services, pay out royalties to artists and labels, and build Label OS, the platform independent labels run their business on. Partners also run the platform under their own brand.

We are a small, senior team, and we work with AI agents every day, in every division.

descriptionByLocale.it:
## Il ruolo

• Impostare le nostre priorità di sicurezza e vedere le correzioni fino a quando non sono verificate.

• Proteggi il nostro cloud e le nostre identità su Google Cloud e Kubernetes: diritti di accesso, chiavi e segreti, esposizione di rete e backup.

• Costruire registrazione e rilevamento, e automatizzare i controlli in modo da eseguire senza di te.

• Lavorare con gli ingegneri sulla sicurezza delle applicazioni: modellazione delle minacce, revisione dei percorsi di codice sensibili, controlli nella pipeline di costruzione e patch management.

• Progettare i controlli intorno vincite e la separazione tra partner.

• Guidare la risposta incidente, compreso il piano e gli esercizi.

• Eseguire i nostri test di sicurezza: un test di penetrazione esterno annuale e test automatizzati, assistiti da AI tra loro.

• Scrivere le poche regole di cui abbiamo bisogno, per i dati dei clienti e per i partner, i fornitori e gli agenti dell'AI, abbastanza breve che le persone li seguono.

## Cosa porti

• 6+ anni in ingegneria, almeno 3 di loro hands-on in sicurezza. Hai iniziato a lavorare in backend, piattaforma o infrastruttura.

• Forte cloud e sicurezza dell'identità, idealmente su Google Cloud, e l'esperienza con Kubernetes.

• Solid applicazione di sicurezza: è possibile rivedere il codice e mostrare un ingegnere la correzione.

• Hai costruito la sicurezza in una piccola o crescente azienda, non solo lavorato all'interno di una grande squadra di sicurezza.

• Hai portato la risposta ad un incidente di sicurezza.

• Usate gli strumenti AI ogni giorno.

• Inglese fluente.
Che bello avere

• PHP, o TypeScript e Node.

• Sicurezza del database su MySQL o PostgreSQL.

• Piattaforme multitenant e flussi di pagamento o di pagamento.

• Singola segnaletica e sicurezza delle tubazioni.

• Legge sulla protezione dei dati svizzera e UE.

• Tedesco.

## Perché unirsi a noi?

• Tutto il problema. Costruisci la funzione di sicurezza e la conduci come cresce, con il supporto della gestione.

• Mani sui sistemi. Questo è un ruolo di ingegneria. Non c'è nessuna squadra da gestire all'inizio, e politiche e audit sono una piccola parte del lavoro.

• Pagamenti veri. Le royalties e i dati dei clienti per artisti e etichette si corrono attraverso i sistemi che si proteggono.

• Squadra AI-native. Gli agenti sono strumenti che usi e attori sicuri.

• Flessibilità. A distanza con ore flessibili, e un ufficio a Zurigo quando si desidera.
Il nostro stack
Google Cloud e Kubernetes, GitLab, TypeScript e Node, PHP, MySQL e PostgreSQL.

Come applicare
Applicare con il CV e alcune linee su un controllo di sicurezza che hai costruito: che cosa era, che cosa la tua parte era, e se funziona ancora.
Si prega di applicare solo attraverso il modulo di richiesta collegato a questo annuncio. Non possiamo considerare le domande inviate via e-mail.
Cosa succede dopo: una breve prima chiamata, un esercizio pratico, e una conversazione con gli ingegneri con cui lavorare.

## Informazioni su di noi

iGroove è una società di musica svizzera redditizia. Consegniamo la musica ai servizi di streaming, paghiamo le royalties agli artisti e alle etichette, e costruiamo Label OS, le etichette indipendenti della piattaforma gestiscono la loro attività. I partner gestiscono anche la piattaforma sotto il proprio marchio.

Siamo una piccola squadra senior, e lavoriamo con agenti dell'IA ogni giorno, in ogni divisione.

descriptionByLocale.de:
## Die Rolle

• Legen Sie unsere Sicherheitsprioritäten fest und sehen Sie die Korrekturen, bis sie verifiziert sind.

• Sichern Sie unsere Cloud und unsere Identitäten in Google Cloud und Kubernetes: Zugriffsrechte, Schlüssel und Geheimnisse, Netzwerk-Exposition und Backups.

• Erstellen Sie Protokollierung und Erkennung und automatisieren Sie die Überprüfungen, damit sie ohne Sie ausgeführt werden.

• Arbeiten Sie mit den Ingenieuren an der Anwendungssicherheit: Bedrohungsmodellierung, Überprüfung sensibler Codepfade, Überprüfungen in der Build-Pipeline und Patch-Management.

• Entwerfen Sie die Kontrollen um Auszahlungen und die Trennung zwischen Partnern.

• Führen Sie die Reaktion auf Vorfälle, einschließlich des Plans und der Übungen.

• Führen Sie unsere Sicherheitstests durch: einen jährlichen externen Penetrationstest und automatisierte, KI-gestützte Tests dazwischen.

• Schreibe die wenigen Regeln, die wir brauchen, für Kundendaten und für Partner, Anbieter und KI-Agenten, kurz genug, dass die Leute sie befolgen.

## Was du mitbringst

• 6+ Jahre in der Technik, mindestens 3 von ihnen Hands-on in der Sicherheit. Sie haben mit Backend-, Plattform- oder Infrastrukturarbeiten begonnen.

• Starke Cloud- und Identitätssicherheit, idealerweise in der Google Cloud, und Erfahrung mit Kubernetes.

• Solide Anwendungssicherheit: Sie können den Code überprüfen und einem Ingenieur den Fix zeigen.

• Sie haben Sicherheit in einem kleinen oder wachsenden Unternehmen aufgebaut und nicht nur in einem großen Sicherheitsteam gearbeitet.

• Sie haben die Antwort auf einen Sicherheitsvorfall geleitet.

• Sie verwenden KI-Tools jeden Tag.

• fließend Englisch.
Nizza zu haben

• PHP oder TypeScript und Node.

• Datenbanksicherheit auf MySQL oder PostgreSQL.

• Multi-Tenant-Plattformen und Zahlungs- oder Auszahlungsströme.

• Single Sign-on und Build Pipeline Sicherheit.

• Schweizer und EU-Datenschutzrecht.

• Deutsch.

## Warum mitmachen?

• Das ganze Problem. Sie bauen die Sicherheitsfunktion auf und führen sie, während sie wächst, mit der Unterstützung des Managements.

• Hände an den Systemen. Dies ist eine technische Rolle. Es gibt kein Team, das zu Beginn verwaltet werden muss, und Richtlinien und Audits sind ein kleiner Teil der Arbeit.

• Echte Einsätze. Lizenzgebühren und Kundendaten für Künstler und Labels durchlaufen die Systeme, die Sie schützen.

• AI-native Team. Agenten sind Werkzeuge, die Sie verwenden, und Schauspieler, die Sie sichern.

• Flexibilität. Remote mit flexiblen Stunden, und ein Büro in Zürich, wenn Sie es wollen.
Unser Stack
Google Cloud und Kubernetes, GitLab, TypeScript und Node, PHP, MySQL und PostgreSQL.

Wie man anwendet
Bewerben Sie sich mit Ihrem Lebenslauf und ein paar Zeilen auf eine Sicherheitskontrolle, die Sie erstellt haben: was es war, was Ihr Teil war und ob es noch läuft.
Bitte bewerben Sie sich nur über das mit dieser Anzeige verlinkte Bewerbungsformular. Wir können Bewerbungen, die per E-Mail verschickt werden, nicht berücksichtigen.
Was als nächstes passiert: ein kurzer erster Anruf, eine praktische Übung und ein Gespräch mit den Ingenieuren, mit denen Sie arbeiten würden.

## Über uns

iGroove ist ein profitables Schweizer Musikunternehmen. Wir liefern Musik an die Streaming-Dienste, zahlen Lizenzgebühren an Künstler und Labels aus und bauen Label OS, die plattformunabhängigen Labels, auf denen sie ihr Geschäft betreiben. Die Partner betreiben die Plattform auch unter ihrer eigenen Marke.

Wir sind ein kleines, leitendes Team und arbeiten jeden Tag mit KI-Agenten in jeder Abteilung zusammen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
## Le rôle

• Définir nos priorités en matière de sécurité et les corriger jusqu'à ce qu'elles soient vérifiées.

• Sécurisez notre cloud et nos identités sur Google Cloud et Kubernetes : droits d'accès, clés et secrets, exposition réseau et sauvegardes.

• Construisez l'enregistrement et la détection, et automatisez les contrôles afin qu'ils fonctionnent sans vous.

• Travailler avec les ingénieurs sur la sécurité des applications : modélisation des menaces, examen des chemins de codes sensibles, contrôles dans le pipeline de construction et gestion des patchs.

• Concevoir les contrôles autour des paiements et la séparation entre les partenaires.

• Diriger l'intervention en cas d'incident, y compris le plan et les exercices.

• Exécutez nos tests de sécurité : un test de pénétration externe annuel et des tests automatisés assistés par l'IA.

• Écrivez les quelques règles dont nous avons besoin, pour les données des clients et pour les partenaires, les fournisseurs et les agents d'IA, assez courtes pour que les gens les suivent.

## Ce que vous apportez

• 6 ans et plus en ingénierie, dont au moins 3 en sécurité. Vous avez commencé à travailler en backend, plate-forme ou infrastructure.

• Sécurité forte du cloud et de l'identité, idéalement sur Google Cloud, et expérience avec Kubernetes.

• Sécurité d'application solide : vous pouvez revoir le code et montrer à un ingénieur la correction.

• Vous avez construit la sécurité dans une petite entreprise ou en croissance, non seulement travaillé au sein d'une grande équipe de sécurité.

• Vous avez mené la réponse à un incident de sécurité.

• Vous utilisez des outils d'IA tous les jours.

• Anglais.
Sympa d'avoir

• PHP, ou TypeScript et Node.

• Sécurité de la base de données sur MySQL ou PostgreSQL.

• Plates-formes multilocataires et flux de paiement ou de paiement.

• Une seule signature et la sécurité des pipelines.

• La législation suisse et communautaire en matière de protection des données.

• Allemand.

## Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

• Tout le problème. Vous construisez la fonction de sécurité et la dirigez à mesure qu'elle grandit, avec le soutien de la direction.

• Mains sur les systèmes. C'est un rôle d'ingénierie. Il n'y a pas d'équipe à gérer au début, et les politiques et les vérifications ne constituent qu'une petite partie du travail.

• De vrais enjeux. Les redevances et les données client pour les artistes et les étiquettes passent par les systèmes que vous protégez.

• L'équipe native d'IA. Les agents sont des outils que vous utilisez et des acteurs sécurisés.

• Flexibilité. À distance avec des heures flexibles, et un bureau à Zurich quand vous le voulez.
Notre pile
Google Cloud et Kubernetes, GitLab, TypeScript et Node, PHP, MySQL et PostgreSQL.

Comment présenter une demande
Appliquer avec votre CV et quelques lignes sur un contrôle de sécurité que vous avez construit: ce qu'il était, ce que votre partie était, et si elle fonctionne encore.
Veuillez ne présenter votre demande qu'au moyen du formulaire de demande lié à cette annonce. Nous ne pouvons pas considérer les demandes envoyées par courriel.
Ce qui se passe ensuite : un premier appel court, un exercice pratique et une conversation avec les ingénieurs avec lesquels vous travailleriez.

## À propos de nous

iGroove est une société de musique suisse rentable. Nous livrons de la musique aux services de streaming, versons des redevances aux artistes et aux labels, et construisons Label OS, les labels indépendants de la plate-forme. Les partenaires gèrent également la plateforme sous leur propre marque.

Nous sommes une petite équipe senior, et nous travaillons avec des agents de l'IA tous les jours, dans chaque division.

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile senior delle operazioni e degli affari aziendali (m/f/d)

titleByLocale.fr: Directeur principal des opérations et des affaires (h/f/d)

jobs.description:
## The Role

• Operational engine: Together with the ops team you take over the day-to-day operations of our distribution and Label OS business, so that our COO can focus on strategic initiatives and agentic systems that will carry more and more of this work. Partner & DSP operations and Business & legal affairs make up the largest part of the role.

• Partner operations: You take partner deals from agreed terms to live — closing execution and onboarding with our Partner Operations Kit, which you improve with every partner — and coordinate catalog migrations, partner revenue reviews and settlements, and partner success management after the deal.

• DSP & delivery operations: You own DSP onboarding end-to-end (feeds, territories, DDEX delivery), day-to-day DSP & Delivery troubleshooting and the operational side of DSPs' policies.

• YouTube & content monetization: You operate YouTube CMS / Content ID — claimed videos, art tracks, monetization & performance improvements, policies, Trust & Safety cases and audits.

• Business & legal affairs: You handle requests outside the SLA via our intake workflow, keep our T&Cs and compliance documentation current, follow through legal cases, takedowns, exclusivity issues and copyright claims, and run the weekly sync with our external counsel.

• Contract lifecycle: You run contracts within a 48-hour SLA — drafting, redlining, review cycles with external counsel, signatures — across distribution agreements, NDAs, and other agreements, licensee monitoring and catalog transaction documentation.

• Compliance & content integrity: You run Spotify PPP compliance, DSP audit responses, monthly penalty settlements and artificial-streaming and customer fraud cases, together with our content identification and fraud detection partners.

• Operational cadences: You own recurring checklists, operational reporting and escalations, and keep SOPs and playbooks current — written so they can be turned into AI agents.

• Working with AI agents: You review the output of our production agents (e.g. release QC, content identification, monitoring), flag quality issues, turn recurring corrections into better SOPs and agents, and take over automated workflows once they are handed over.

• Building agents: Over time, you build your own agents for recurring workflows in your area, within our agent quality standard.

• Service levels: You work to clear commitments — contracts within 48 hours, fraud cases triaged within 24 hours, YouTube Trust & Safety issues resolved within 48 hours, escalations resolved or routed within 4 hours, partner revenue reviews completed by month-end.

• Your first 6 months: After about three months you own all areas and the COO is down to a weekly check-in; contracts leave within the SLA without the COO in the loop, new partners go live through the Kit, and you are the day-to-day reviewer of at least one production agent.

## What you bring

• Experience: 5+ years in music distribution, label services or DSP operations.

• DSP & YouTube: Deep knowledge of the DSP landscape (Spotify, Apple Music, TikTok, YouTube, Amazon Music) plus Rights Management / Content ID (YouTube, TikTok, Meta) experience at scale.

• Delivery & royalties: Familiarity with DDEX (ERN), royalty accounting, revenue-share models, settlement processes and DSP reporting formats.

• Legal & contracts: Hands-on experience with distribution agreements, NDAs and licensing terms; confident redlining; ideally experience working with external counsel.

• Compliance: Experience with content integrity, artificial-streaming response and platform compliance programs.

• Organisation: You run 10+ parallel workstreams with clear ownership, deadlines and escalation paths.

• Stakeholder management: You deal confidently with partners, DSPs, external counsels and internal teams — often all on the same day.

• Tools: Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Customer Support Solutions and Claude/ChatGPT, or similar tools — and you learn new tools quickly.

• AI in daily work: You already use AI tools every day, on your own initiative — and you are senior enough to challenge their output instead of following it.

• Languages: Fluent English and business-level German.

• Way of working: Process-oriented, SLA-driven, documentation-first, a proactive problem solver, comfortable with ambiguity, and good at the Pareto cut.

• Nice to have: automation tools (n8n, Zapier) or first agents you have built yourself.

• Scope of the role: A senior execution role with real ownership and a real voice: you prepare and execute, while deal structuring and final legal decisions stay with the COO — and you are expected to challenge processes and standards that don't work in practice and to bring improvement proposals; we improve them together. Over time the role grows into building and running AI agents for its own area. It is not a strategy, sales, product or accounting role, and it starts without direct reports — people leadership can grow over time.

## Why join us?

• Ownership from day one: You join a small, experienced team with direct access to the COO and real responsibility for the operations of the business.

• Right timing: You join while a music distribution company turns its operations over to agentic AI — and you shape how that works in practice.

• Growth path: From running operations to building agents of your own, in a company where AI is part of every division.

• Flexible working model: attractive salary package, flexible hours and remote work within the EU timezone or hybrid at our office in Pfäffikon SZ.

## About us

iGroove is a profitable Swiss music company. We deliver music to the streaming services, pay out royalties to artists and labels, and build Label OS, the platform independent labels run their business on. Partners also run the platform under their own brand.

We are a small, senior team, and we work with AI agents every day, in every division.

descriptionByLocale.it:
## La tua missione

• Motore operativo: Insieme con il team ops si prende il sopravvento delle operazioni quotidiane della nostra distribuzione e del business di Label OS, in modo che il nostro COO può concentrarsi su iniziative strategiche e sistemi agentici che porteranno sempre più di questo lavoro. Le operazioni Partner & DSP e Business & Legal Affairs costituiscono la maggior parte del ruolo.

• Operazioni partner: Lei prende accordi di partner da termini concordati per vivere — l'esecuzione di chiusura e l'imbarco con il nostro Kit Operazioni Partner, che migliora con ogni partner — e coordina le migrazioni di catalogo, le recensioni dei ricavi dei partner e gli insediamenti, e la gestione del successo dei partner dopo l'accordo.

• DSP & consegna: Lei possiede DSP onboarding end-to-end (feeds, territori, consegna DDEX), DSP di giorno in giorno e risoluzione dei problemi di consegna e il lato operativo delle politiche di DSPs.

• YouTube & content monetization: si gestisce YouTube CMS / Content ID — video rivendicati, tracce d'arte, monetizzazione e miglioramenti delle prestazioni, politiche, casi di fiducia e sicurezza e audit.

• Affari & legali: Gestisci richieste al di fuori della SLA tramite il nostro flusso di lavoro di aspirazione, mantieni le nostre T&C e la documentazione di conformità corrente, segui attraverso casi legali, arresti, problemi di esclusività e reclami di copyright, e gestisci la sincronizzazione settimanale con il nostro consulente esterno.

• Il ciclo di vita del contratto: Lei esegue contratti all'interno di un SLA di 48 ore — redazione, ridistribuzione, cicli di revisione con consulente esterno, firme — attraverso accordi di distribuzione, NDA, e altri accordi, monitoraggio del licenziatario e documentazione delle transazioni del catalogo.

• Conformità e integrità dei contenuti: Lei esegue la conformità di Spotify PPP, le risposte di audit DSP, gli insediamenti mensili di penalità e i casi di frode artificiale e cliente, insieme ai nostri partner di identificazione dei contenuti e di rilevamento delle frodi.

• Le cadenze operative: Lei possiede le liste di controllo ricorrenti, i rapporti operativi e le escalation, e mantiene le SOP e i playbook attuali — scritti in modo che possano essere trasformati in agenti dell'IA.

• Lavorare con agenti dell'IA: Si esamina l'output dei nostri agenti di produzione (ad esempio, rilascio QC, identificazione dei contenuti, monitoraggio), problemi di qualità della bandiera, trasformare le correzioni ricorrenti in migliori SOP e agenti, e prendere i flussi di lavoro automatizzati una volta consegnati.

• Agenti edili: Col tempo, costruisci i tuoi agenti per i flussi di lavoro ricorrenti nella tua zona, all'interno del nostro standard di qualità agente.

• Livelli di servizio: Lei lavora per eliminare gli impegni — contratti entro 48 ore, casi di frode triaged entro 24 ore, problemi di YouTube Trust & Safety risolti entro 48 ore, escalation risolti o instradati entro 4 ore, recensioni dei ricavi partner completate da fine mese.

• I tuoi primi 6 mesi: Dopo circa tre mesi possiedi tutte le aree e il COO è sceso a un check-in settimanale; i contratti partono all'interno della SLA senza la COO nel loop, i nuovi partner vanno in diretta attraverso il Kit, e tu sei il recensore giornaliero di almeno un agente di produzione.

## Il tuo profilo

• Esperienza: 5+ anni di distribuzione musicale, servizi di etichetta o operazioni DSP.

• DSP & YouTube: profonda conoscenza del paesaggio DSP (Spotify, Apple Music, TikTok, YouTube, Amazon Music) oltre a Gestione dei diritti / Content ID (YouTube, TikTok, Meta) esperienza in scala.

• Consegna & royalties: Familiarità con DDEX (ERN), contabilità di royalty, modelli di azionariato, processi di regolamento e formati di report DSP.

• Legale & contract: Esperienza pratica con accordi di distribuzione, NDA e termini di licenza; arrossamento sicuro; esperienza ideale di lavoro con consulenza esterna.

• Compliance: Esperienza con integrità dei contenuti, risposta a flusso artificiale e programmi di conformità della piattaforma.

• Organizzazione: Si esegue 10+ flussi di lavoro paralleli con chiara proprietà, scadenze e percorsi di escalation.

• Gestione degli Stakeholder: Si tratta con fiducia di partner, DSP, consulenti esterni e team interni — spesso tutto lo stesso giorno.

• Strumenti: Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Customer Support Solutions e Claude/ChatGPT, o strumenti simili, e si impara rapidamente nuovi strumenti.

• AI nel lavoro quotidiano: Si utilizza già strumenti AI ogni giorno, su propria iniziativa — e si è abbastanza senior per sfidare il loro output invece di seguirlo.

• Lingue: Inglese fluente e tedesco di livello aziendale.

• Modo di lavoro: Process-oriented, SLA-driven, documentazione-primo, un problem solving proattivo, confortevole con ambiguità, e buono al taglio Pareto.

• Bello da avere: strumenti di automazione (n8n, Zapier) o primi agenti che avete costruito voi stessi.

• Scopo del ruolo: un ruolo di esecuzione senior con la proprietà reale e una voce reale: ti prepari ed eserciti, mentre le decisioni legali di strutturazione degli accordi e finali rimangono con il COO - e ti aspetti di sfidare processi e standard che non lavorano nella pratica e di portare proposte di miglioramento; li miglioriamo insieme. Col tempo il ruolo cresce nella costruzione e nell'esecuzione di agenti AI per la propria area. Non è una strategia, vendite, prodotto o ruolo contabile, e inizia senza rapporti diretti — la leadership delle persone può crescere nel tempo.

## Perché noi?

descriptionByLocale.en:
## The Role

• Operational engine: Together with the ops team you take over the day-to-day operations of our distribution and Label OS business, so that our COO can focus on strategic initiatives and agentic systems that will carry more and more of this work. Partner & DSP operations and Business & legal affairs make up the largest part of the role.

• Partner operations: You take partner deals from agreed terms to live — closing execution and onboarding with our Partner Operations Kit, which you improve with every partner — and coordinate catalog migrations, partner revenue reviews and settlements, and partner success management after the deal.

• DSP & delivery operations: You own DSP onboarding end-to-end (feeds, territories, DDEX delivery), day-to-day DSP & Delivery troubleshooting and the operational side of DSPs' policies.

• YouTube & content monetization: You operate YouTube CMS / Content ID — claimed videos, art tracks, monetization & performance improvements, policies, Trust & Safety cases and audits.

• Business & legal affairs: You handle requests outside the SLA via our intake workflow, keep our T&Cs and compliance documentation current, follow through legal cases, takedowns, exclusivity issues and copyright claims, and run the weekly sync with our external counsel.

• Contract lifecycle: You run contracts within a 48-hour SLA — drafting, redlining, review cycles with external counsel, signatures — across distribution agreements, NDAs, and other agreements, licensee monitoring and catalog transaction documentation.

• Compliance & content integrity: You run Spotify PPP compliance, DSP audit responses, monthly penalty settlements and artificial-streaming and customer fraud cases, together with our content identification and fraud detection partners.

• Operational cadences: You own recurring checklists, operational reporting and escalations, and keep SOPs and playbooks current — written so they can be turned into AI agents.

• Working with AI agents: You review the output of our production agents (e.g. release QC, content identification, monitoring), flag quality issues, turn recurring corrections into better SOPs and agents, and take over automated workflows once they are handed over.

• Building agents: Over time, you build your own agents for recurring workflows in your area, within our agent quality standard.

• Service levels: You work to clear commitments — contracts within 48 hours, fraud cases triaged within 24 hours, YouTube Trust & Safety issues resolved within 48 hours, escalations resolved or routed within 4 hours, partner revenue reviews completed by month-end.

• Your first 6 months: After about three months you own all areas and the COO is down to a weekly check-in; contracts leave within the SLA without the COO in the loop, new partners go live through the Kit, and you are the day-to-day reviewer of at least one production agent.

## What you bring

• Experience: 5+ years in music distribution, label services or DSP operations.

• DSP & YouTube: Deep knowledge of the DSP landscape (Spotify, Apple Music, TikTok, YouTube, Amazon Music) plus Rights Management / Content ID (YouTube, TikTok, Meta) experience at scale.

• Delivery & royalties: Familiarity with DDEX (ERN), royalty accounting, revenue-share models, settlement processes and DSP reporting formats.

• Legal & contracts: Hands-on experience with distribution agreements, NDAs and licensing terms; confident redlining; ideally experience working with external counsel.

• Compliance: Experience with content integrity, artificial-streaming response and platform compliance programs.

• Organisation: You run 10+ parallel workstreams with clear ownership, deadlines and escalation paths.

• Stakeholder management: You deal confidently with partners, DSPs, external counsels and internal teams — often all on the same day.

• Tools: Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Customer Support Solutions and Claude/ChatGPT, or similar tools — and you learn new tools quickly.

• AI in daily work: You already use AI tools every day, on your own initiative — and you are senior enough to challenge their output instead of following it.

• Languages: Fluent English and business-level German.

• Way of working: Process-oriented, SLA-driven, documentation-first, a proactive problem solver, comfortable with ambiguity, and good at the Pareto cut.

• Nice to have: automation tools (n8n, Zapier) or first agents you have built yourself.

• Scope of the role: A senior execution role with real ownership and a real voice: you prepare and execute, while deal structuring and final legal decisions stay with the COO — and you are expected to challenge processes and standards that don't work in practice and to bring improvement proposals; we improve them together. Over time the role grows into building and running AI agents for its own area. It is not a strategy, sales, product or accounting role, and it starts without direct reports — people leadership can grow over time.

## Why join us?

• Ownership from day one: You join a small, experienced team with direct access to the COO and real responsibility for the operations of the business.

• Right timing: You join while a music distribution company turns its operations over to agentic AI — and you shape how that works in practice.

• Growth path: From running operations to building agents of your own, in a company where AI is part of every division.

• Flexible working model: attractive salary package, flexible hours and remote work within the EU timezone or hybrid at our office in Pfäffikon SZ.

## About us

iGroove is a profitable Swiss music company. We deliver music to the streaming services, pay out royalties to artists and labels, and build Label OS, the platform independent labels run their business on. Partners also run the platform under their own brand.

We are a small, senior team, and we work with AI agents every day, in every division.

• Conformité & intégrité du contenu: Vous exécutez Spotify conformité PPP, réponses d'audit DSP, règlements de pénalité mensuels et cas de diffusion artificielle et de fraude client, ainsi que nos partenaires d'identification de contenu et de détection de fraude.

• Niveaux de service: Vous travaillez à clarifier les engagements — contrats dans les 48 heures, cas de fraude triés dans les 24 heures, YouTube Trust & Sécurité problèmes résolus dans les 48 heures, escalades résolues ou acheminés dans les 4 heures, examen des revenus des partenaires complétés d'ici la fin du mois.

• Gestion des intervenants : Vous traitez avec confiance avec des partenaires, des PSD, des conseillers externes et des équipes internes, souvent le même jour.

• Mode de travail: orienté processus, SLA, documentation-premier, un résolveur de problèmes proactif, confortable avec ambiguïté, et bon à la coupe Pareto.

Il ne s'agit pas d'une stratégie, d'une vente, d'un produit ou d'un rôle comptable, et il commence sans rapport direct.

Nos clients incluent certains des noms les plus respectés dans la musique indépendante. Nous sommes une petite équipe senior qui exploite pleinement l'IA dans chaque division. Nous nous déplaçons rapidement, expédions des produits réels, et construisons les outils que les étiquettes indépendantes doivent réellement concurrencer.
